description: The arg(u) wall is a QUADRATURE effect: the c₃ front proved the NZ bar-odd/CS face nzImVolume=(√3/2)r²sin(2φ) is FROZEN on the real substrate ray φ=0. The μ₀ g₂ is the bar-even/Volume face = the cos partner nzReVolume=(√3/2)r²cos(2φ), MAXIMAL (cos 0=1) and STATIONARY (even in φ, zero phase-slope) at the SAME φ=0 — doubly anchor-smooth. Pythagorean nzRe²+nzIm²=(3/4)r⁴; at φ=0 all the energy is in the bar-even face (CS=0, Vol=peak). So the wall that kills c₃ LEAVES g₂ maximal — g₂ lives where c₃ dies. Corrects the prior 'r frozen like c₃'. Does NOT derive g₂'s value (=trefoil bar-even NZ coeff, #4319). scope-(a), audit-only, nothing wired.
tier: quadrature structure of the arg(u) wall (exact trig; no fit)

A_quadrature.meaning: on the real substrate ray φ=0 ALL the NZ quadratic is in the bar-EVEN (Volume) face; the bar-ODD (CS, c₃) face is null.

B_phase_slopes_at_phi0.d_nzIm_dphi: 0.07536839 (= √3 r², MAX slope — c₃'s steepest, but value 0)
B_phase_slopes_at_phi0.parity: nzIm ODD in φ (sin) ⇒ φ=0 steepest; nzRe EVEN (cos) ⇒ φ=0 extremum (nzReVolume_phase_even).

C_verdict.wall_is_quadrature: the arg(u) wall freezes the bar-odd CS face (sin, φ=0) but leaves the bar-even Volume face (cos, φ=0) MAXIMAL and stationary.
C_verdict.corrects: the prior 'r frozen like c₃' pessimism — r is NOT in the frozen channel; the bar-even face is alive at the substrate.
C_verdict.still_open: g₂'s VALUE/r = the TREFOIL bar-even NZ coefficient (leading 1 from the coloring, #4319); the √3/2 here is the figure-eight modulus (illustrative).
